dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: If the opportunity arises, I would like to take you diving with me.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: The world is full of troubles. But when compared with the vastness of the sea, all those troubles seem to just fade away.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Though the ages pass and time brings change, the sea continues as it always has. As I float down among the depths of the sea, a deep tranquility permeates my heart.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: There are times when I feel utterly exhausted, so I thought I should share with you the way that I unwind.

choices.text: But how would I breathe underwater?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Mm... That is indeed a problem.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Wait, I've come up with a clever solution.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I'll wrap the two of us in a gigantic bubble... We can slowly sink down into the sea together.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: This way, we can journey together underwater! You'll feel refreshed before you know it.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Though I've never gone diving together with anyone before, I must say that I certainly look forward to it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there anything that I should prepare beforehand?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: No, not at all. The purpose of the trip is to relax, after all. Simply do as you please.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Besides, you will have the "grand strategist" accompanying you.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: You need only focus on resting and I'll take care of the details.

choices.text: I wouldn't call myself the best swimmer...
